mapper.sql: select oi.id, oi.order_number, oi.user_id, oi.type, oi.order_count, oi.amount, oi.rebate_percentage, oi.rebate, oi.upper_rebate_percentage, oi.upper_rebate, oi.status, oi.expiry_time, oi.product_id, oi.extra_commission_id, oi.create_time, oi.remarks, oi.comment_id, oi.link_id, ou.username as username, COALESCE(oi.product_image, g.image) as product_image, COALESCE(oi.product_title, g.title) as product_title, COALESCE(gecs.amount, 0) as extra_commission_amount from order_info oi left join order_user ou on oi.user_id = ou.id left join goods g on oi.product_id = g.id left join goods_extra_commission_setting gecs on oi.extra_commission_id = gecs.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_number, type, order_count, amount, rebate_percentage, rebate, status, expiry_time, product_id, create_time, product_image, product_title FROM order_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = '1' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, order_number, type, order_count, amount, rebate, upper_rebate, status, extra_commission_id, link_id FROM order_info WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, order_number, user_id, type, order_count, amount, rebate, upper_rebate, status, extra_commission_id, link_id FROM order_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_count = #{orderCount} AND type = '1' AND status IN ('1', '2') ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, order_number, type, order_count, amount, rebate_percentage, rebate, status, expiry_time, product_id, create_time, product_image, product_title FROM order_info WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
